import hashlib
from jifunze_lab import lnd

paid = [p for p in lnd("alice").payments() if p["status"] == "SUCCEEDED"]
last = paid[-1]
digest = hashlib.sha256(bytes.fromhex(last["payment_preimage"])).hexdigest()
print("payment hash:", last["payment_hash"])
print("sha256(preimage):", digest)
print("match:", digest == last["payment_hash"])
